name: Online
description: The modem programs: TERM, a terminal for the modem port (dial the bulletin board or a telnet host, XMODEM), and IRC, an IRC client (/connect, /join, /msg, /query ...), each with its directory of numbers and servers (TERM.DIR, IRC.DIR). Put it in B:, then B: and IRC or TERM.
credit: Costin Stroie; MIT licence. Source in system/term.asm and system/irc.asm.
